name: [Forward Alliance] Announcement Channel Read Only
description: Restricts configured announcement channels to admins while allowing other channels to behave normally.

settings_schema.header: Configure the channel slug that should stay read-only for non-admins.
settings_schema.footer: Use the URL slug, not the display name. Example: announcements.

settings.help_text: Message shown when a non-admin tries to post or edit in a restricted channel.
settings.default: This is a read-only announcement channel. Only admins can post here.
